skill.name: ecommerce-review-insights
skill.description: 当用户需要归纳商品评价中的优缺点、购买顾虑和改进建议时使用。支持各平台提供的评价文本或表格，也可通过小红书商品链接或sku_id在线分析评价。输出带原话依据、评价条数与范围说明的主题表；已有资料可直接分析。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Summarize product reviews with theme counts, short quotes, sample limits, and up to three suggested improvements.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts came from Markdown formatting, documentation, or readable Chinese text. The online CLI runs an unpinned npm package with access to a service credential, and its examples do not specify safe handling of shell arguments. No evidence of an embedded payload or an attempt to override the audit was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Online commands and authentication checks run a mutable npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify an exact CLI version, including dependencies. Require approval before installing it, and run it with access only to the scoped service credential.

remediation.issue: The CLI can persist an API key in a user configuration file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an OS credential store or a managed secret. Make file storage opt-in, document how to remove the key, and keep credential values out of diagnostics.

remediation.issue: Shell examples accept user and service values without specifying safe argument handling.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values as separate arguments through a process API with shell parsing disabled. Validate product links and identifiers before use.

remediation.issue: Online lookup accepts full share messages even when only the product URL is needed.
remediation.suggestion: Extract and validate the Xiaohongshu product URL locally. Send only the required URL or SKU ID through an approved connection.

content.value_statement: Long review lists make it hard to separate recurring concerns from isolated reports. This skill groups feedback by theme and shows counts, quotes, and sample limits.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes pasted reviews and readable tables from any platform without an online lookup.
Uses SocialDataX to retrieve Xiaohongshu reviews by SKU ID or resolve a product link first.
Retrieves requested replies when context matters and counts them separately from purchase reviews.
Counts each review once per theme and reports the sample size and any deduplication rules.
Supports themes with short quotes and source references, then suggests up to three improvements or checks.
limitations: Online review retrieval is limited to Xiaohongshu products and needs an authenticated SocialDataX connection.
Online retrieval defaults to one page. Sorting, filters, and failed pages can affect coverage.
Review mentions do not establish return rates, store-wide complaint rates, or verified product defects.
Unreadable files require a CSV export or pasted text. Missing ratings, dates, and product variants are not inferred.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Product Checks
use_cases.description: Review reported quality and fit concerns. Separate common complaints from rare issues that need verification.

use_cases.title: Clarify Product Listings
use_cases.description: Find repeated questions about size, compatibility, or what comes in the box. Use review quotes to support listing changes.

use_cases.title: Improve Support Answers
use_cases.description: Group delivery and service concerns in a review export. Use replies for context without counting them as purchase reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Pasted Reviews
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review a small set of customer comments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize these pasted reviews. List recurring praise and complaints, and support each theme with one short quote and its row number.

prompt_templates.title: Count Themes in a CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the attached CSV. Deduplicate repeated review IDs and report the original and analyzed totals. Count each review once per theme.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Xiaohongshu Sample
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Check one product using an approved connection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my approved SocialDataX connection to analyze one page of reviews for this Xiaohongshu SKU. Report the sort order, filters, and sample size.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Product Variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare two review samples with known variant labels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the two supplied samples using the same theme rules. Report counts, denominators, and quotes for each variant. Note coverage gaps and suggest up to three checks.

output_examples.input: Five pasted reviews for a phone case.
output: Sample: Five reviews analyzed. Dates and purchase status were not provided.
Fit concern: Two of five reviews. Row 4: "The corners felt loose."
Suggested check: Verify model compatibility. These reports do not establish a defect.

output_examples.input: A CSV with ten review rows, one repeated review ID, and two seller replies.
output: Sample: Nine unique reviews analyzed after removing one repeated ID. Two seller replies were excluded from the review counts.
Packaging praise: Three of nine reviews. Review 7: "The box was well padded."
Delivery concern: Two of nine reviews. The sample does not establish a delivery failure rate.

best_practices: Include product variants, dates, review IDs, and collection filters when available.
Remove phone numbers, addresses, and order numbers before sharing review material.
Keep sorting, filters, and counting rules consistent when comparing samples.
anti_patterns: Treating one page of reviews as complete coverage.
Counting seller replies as purchase reviews or labeling repeated text as proven fraud.
Pasting API keys into prompts or including them in reports.

faq.question: Can I analyze reviews without connecting to SocialDataX?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the reviews or provide a readable table. Supplied review material does not require an API key or an online lookup.

faq.question: Can it fetch reviews from other marketplaces?
faq.answer: No. Online retrieval is limited to Xiaohongshu products. You can still provide exports from other marketplaces.

faq.question: Does online retrieval cost credits?
faq.answer: SocialDataX may charge credits for online requests. Review the service terms before requesting additional pages.

faq.question: How many reviews will it retrieve?
faq.answer: It starts with one page. More pages can be requested within an agreed sample limit when the service returns a continuation token.

faq.question: Does it count replies as reviews?
faq.answer: No. Replies can provide context, but they are reported separately and do not increase the review count.

faq.question: Why can theme percentages add up to more than 100 percent?
faq.answer: One review can mention several themes. It is counted once in each relevant theme.
